tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page, app and store-screenshot background. The Glyph Matrix lives on black, so every surface starts here.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and grouped settings on `ground`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Rows inside a card, toy-list cards, pressed state of `surface`.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative 1px dividers between rows. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Outline of secondary buttons and steppers (3.3:1 on `surface-raised`, 4.1:1 on `ground`).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headlines, body copy and numbers on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, summaries and sub-headlines on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (6.8:1 at worst).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Mono labels and captions on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (5.1:1 at worst). Not for long reading.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary pill button per screen.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: THE family signature: the red dot. One per view: the dot before MADE FOR GLYPH MATRIX, a headline full stop, the one red pixel in an app icon. Never text, never a fill behind text, never an LED in a picture of the real device (the hardware is white-only).

tokens.name: led-on
tokens.usage: A fully lit LED (snake head, food, player) in `GlyphMatrix`.

tokens.name: led-mid
tokens.usage: A half-lit LED (snake body, obstacles) in `GlyphMatrix`.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit LED cell. Shows the 25x25 grid so a picture reads as the matrix, not as pixel art.

tokens.name: lens
tokens.usage: The glass disc behind the matrix in `GlyphMatrix` lens mode and in app icons.

tokens.name: lens-rim
tokens.usage: Thin ring around the lens disc.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Store screenshot headline (at 1080px canvas: 190px). Latin only: Doto has no Cyrillic.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: App name on the main screen. Latin only.

styles.name: score
styles.usage: Scores and counters, always zero-padded to 3 digits.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Any Cyrillic headline, in place of a `display-*` style.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Tilt your phone to move the snake.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase labels, the signature line, score captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its value.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked buttons; icon to text.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a list.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; Android screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Screen padding on the main screen; gap headline to matrix.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top air above the app name.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small chips, stepper buttons.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and toy-list rows (matches Nothing OS cards).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: All buttons are pills.

matrix.note: Physical facts of the Phone (3) Glyph Matrix, used by GlyphMatrix and by the Android code.

tokens.name: matrix-cells
tokens.usage: Cells per side. Phone (4a) Pro has 13; Glyph Snake and Flappy Box target Phone (3) only.

tokens.name: matrix-led-size
tokens.usage: LED dot size relative to its cell; the gap shows the grid.

tokens.name: matrix-lens-inset
tokens.usage: Space between the lens rim and the outermost LEDs.
